disclosure: Diagnostic only — not a published SLO.
interpretation: APPEND SHORT-CIRCUIT: no-append 516148 vs full 124992 ops/s (4.1×) — if ratio ≫1, append_frame (Blake+buffer) is the data-cooking hog.
APPEND SC + no-index: 591969 ops/s (vs no-append-with-index 516148) — residual after skipping Blake/append.
INDEX BISECT: no-index 137538 ≈ full 124992 ops/s (ratio 1.10×) — dual-index publish is NOT the killer; **data cooking** (encode/append/Blake+copy + write) dominates.
DISK BISECT: Discard 167276 / DevNull 157627 / Real 124992 ops/s — partial OS cost (Real/Discard=0.75×).
Raw /dev/null 3913926 vs raw work-file 1027690 ops/s — pure write_all media delta without Residiuum.
Buffered put is 44% of pure-Blake ops/s — Blake-scale cost may matter.
Memory 879682 → Discard-Buffered 167276 → Real-Buffered 124992: gap Memory→Discard is **pre-disk store work**; Discard→Real is **tail I/O**.
Raw write_all 1027690 ops/s vs Buffered put 124992 — store adds 8.2× wall vs raw same-size writes.
Note: long peer multi-seal runs can still add seal_rotate wall; this micro uses 512MiB seal so mid seals are off.
